The '''Herdessa sector''' was a sector located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda]], [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian]], [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular]], and [[Daimar sector/Legends|Daimar sectors]]. The planet of [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]] was located within it along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].
